title: 600MM Wafer-Level Fan Out on Panel Level Processing with 6-Sided Die Protection
notes: Nepes 600x600 mm panel M-Series (DECA-licensed) single-die FOPLP case study: flow, die shift, CSAM, 4-panel warpage/TTV evaluation, segmentation usable-area table. No RDL dimensions or reliability data.

orgs: Intel Corp. (Components Research, Technology & Manufacturing Group); Intel Corp. (Assembly & Test Technology Development, Technology & Manufacturing Group)

title: Reliability characterization of Chip-on-Wafer-on-Substrate (CoWoS) 3D IC integration technology
notes: 28 nm logic + two 40 nm HBM-mimic dies on 26x24 mm TSV interposer, 40x40 mm FCBGA; 40 um ubump, 200 um SnPb C4; component and board-level reliability.

title: Integrated Optical Interconnect Systems (iOIS) for Silicon Photonics Applications in HPC
notes: Platform/concept paper: COUPE2.0 optical engine on CoWoS-based composite interposer (CI). Headline numbers in tables; measurement vs simulation basis not stated; no build details.

title: Collective die-to-wafer assembly process for optically interconnected System-on-wafer
notes: imec CoD2W dielectric bonding of 7.2 mm, 100 um SiN-waveguide PIC dies onto 300 mm optical interconnect wafer; carrier-adhesion fix raises transfer yield 74% to 96%, 2.4 um m+3s, EVC loss <0.5 dB.

title: High Performance and Energy Efficient Computing with Advanced SoIC Scaling
notes: TSMC 3 um pitch F2F CoW SoIC4 TV, 6x6 mm top die on 16x16 mm bottom die: WAT daisy-chain yield vs die shift, Kelvin Rc vs 9 um SoIC1, uHAST/TCC.

title: Dry processes to form fine features on advanced substrates
notes: Coupon-level DFR lamination, laser digital lithography, ICP+CCP F-based dry etch of ABF on Cu; vias/trenches 5-10 um CD, AR 1-2. No metallization.

title: High Bandwidth and Energy Efficient Electrical-Optical System Integration Using COUPE Technology
notes: Simulation-only (HSPICE, ADS, HBM3 IBIS): SoIC vs microbump EIC-PIC optical engine, enhanced vs conventional interposer. Nearly all results normalized; no absolute dimensions.
